Initial release of eth-payment: generate instant EVM payment links and QR codes.

- Create EIP-681 Ethereum payment links and QR codes for ETH and ERC-20 tokens.
- Supports Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, and Polygon networks.
- Zero configuration required—no servers, no API keys, runs locally.
- Features include payment requests, invoices, donation links, and address validation.
- List supported chains and tokens, output QR codes or JSON for easy integration.
